name: perrinn_fw_sa_half
notes: Phase 5: PERRINN 2017 front wing, HALF model (symmetry plane at the car centreline), on-car position (rake 0.495 deg, lowest point 85.6 mm), moving ground, 50 m/s, Spalart-Allmaras. Surface cells 3.1 mm on flat areas, 0.8 mm on curved areas and edges (the full model at 1.6-0.8 mm passed 18.9 M cells before finishing refinement). Aref = 1 m^2 for the full wing: Cd/Cl are full-wing S.Cd / S.Cl in m^2. First attempt crashed while adding the wall layer (snappyHexMesh face merging, 'Multiple outside loops'); mergeFaces is now switched off.
